instruction: Mark all emails in the Sent folder as read

rules.sql: select sum(1) > 0 from messageAttributes where attributeID = 59 and value = 1 and messageID in (select id from messages where folderID = 10);

metadata.explanation: Task requires marking all emails in Sent folder (folderID=10) as read. The evaluator checks if attributeID=59 (read attribute) is set to value=1 for messages in Sent. Verified from database: Sent has 2 emails.

llm_judge_reasons: SQL query only verifies that at least one email is marked as read (sum(1) > 0), not that ALL emails are marked as read
Instruction requires marking ALL emails in Sent folder as read, but the evaluator will pass if even 1 out of 2 emails is marked read
Query returns 1 if any messageID in folderID=10 has attributeID=59 with value=1, which is insufficient for verifying complete task completion
Metadata states there are 2 emails in Sent folder, but the SQL logic doesn't verify both are marked as read
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Change SQL query to verify ALL emails are marked as read by checking count equality

Suggested query: 'select (select count(*) from messageAttributes where attributeID = 59 and value = 1 and messageID in (select id from messages where folderID = 10)) = (select count(*) from messages where folderID = 10);'

Alternative: Use 'select count(*) from messages where folderID = 10 and id not in (select messageID from messageAttributes where attributeID = 59 and value = 1) = 0;' to ensure no unread emails remain
The query must return 1 only when the count of read emails equals the total count of emails in the Sent folder
